title: Death Coordinates
description: This datapack shows in chat your latest death point
body:
# Death Coordinates ☠

Never lose your stuff again. The moment you die, your exact death coordinates appear in chat — X / Y / Z and the dimension, color-coded. Forgot them? Type /trigger deathpos at any time to see your last death point again.

## Features


💀 Instant chat message with your death coordinates (Overworld / Nether / End aware)

🔁 /trigger deathpos — recall your last death point anytime, no OP needed

🪶 Ultra lightweight: pure scoreboard functions, zero lag, no items, no worldgen

🌍 Works in singleplayer, Realms, and multiplayer servers

🔧 No setup: drop it in datapacks/, done


## Compatibility

Built with commands that are stable across versions, plus a dual folder layout (function + functions) and a multi-format pack.mcmeta, so one file works from Minecraft 1.19.4 all the way to 26.1.2 (and likely beyond). If an old version shows a yellow "made for a newer version" warning, just click Enable anyway — it works.
